summary: IDS feed s162_triple is degraded with 3 faults: VLAN 20 missing (50% untagged), 5.3% jumbo frames >1518B dropped by IDS NIC, and 27.7% VXLAN-encapsulated traffic hiding inner payload from inspection.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker is stripping 802.1Q tags or trunk misconfigured to not forward VLAN 20 to this IDS port - 50% of packets arrive untagged and required VLAN 20 never appears despite IDS requiring VLANs 10 and 20.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS is blind to entire VLAN 20 segment; cannot apply VLAN-aware policies or detect lateral movement/segmentation violations on that VLAN, halving expected coverage.

recommended_fix.why: Restore 802.1Q tags and ensure broker trunk forwards both VLANs 10 and 20 to the IDS so VLAN-based detection and correlation work.

findings.root_cause: Broker forwards jumbo/VXLAN-expanded frames up to 8104 bytes to a 1 Gbps IDS port limited to 1518 bytes without MTU handling or slicing; NIC drops oversize frames in hardware.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS silently drops 5.3% of frames (114/2141) - complete flows with large payloads are lost, creating detection gaps for exploits, file transfers and exfiltration carried in large frames despite IDS needing full payload.

recommended_fix.why: Enable 9000B jumbo support on IDS NIC/switch path or configure broker to handle MTU (fragment/slice-aware) so frames are not hardware-dropped; jumbo enable preferred because IDS needs full payload and slicing would break inspection.

findings.root_cause: 27.7% of traffic (593/2141 frames) arrives inside VXLAN encapsulation because packet broker is not terminating/stripping tunnels before delivery; IDS sees only outer VTEP headers.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS cannot parse inner Ethernet/IP and signatures fail on encapsulated traffic - attacks, C2 and lateral movement inside the VXLAN overlay are invisible to IDS despite being delivered.

recommended_fix.why: Terminate/strip VXLAN at the packet broker and deliver decapsulated inner packets so IDS can inspect true payload with existing signatures.
